questions.stem: How does ATP release energy for use in cells?

options.text: ATP is burned like a fuel
ATP is hydrolysed into ADP and a phosphate group, releasing energy
ATP is combined with glucose to produce energy
ATP absorbs energy from the surroundings

questions.explanation: ATP releases energy when it is hydrolysed (broken down with water) by the enzyme ATPase into ADP and an inorganic phosphate group. This releases a small, usable amount of energy.
